description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldCurrency class, a specialized widget for handling currency fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for rendering currency fields in list views, filtering, and handling currency-related data display logic.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldCurrency
classes.description: A widget class for managing currency display in list views and filters, extending the base SugarWidgetFieldInt class.

methods.name: get_currency
methods.description: Retrieves a global currency object based on the current user preference, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with a layout manager and retrieves the report attribute.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates the HTML for displaying a currency field in a list view, including inline editing support.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the currency value without HTML, applying number formatting.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Builds a SQL filter for equality comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals
methods.description: Builds a SQL filter for inequality comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterGreater
methods.description: Builds a SQL filter for greater-than comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterLess
methods.description: Builds a SQL filter for less-than comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween
methods.description: Builds a SQL filter for a range of values.

methods.name: isSystemCurrency
methods.description: Checks if the layout definition is linked to the system's default currency.

methods.name: querySelect
methods.description: Generates SQL select statement components, including currency ID if necessary.

methods.name: queryGroupBy
methods.description: Generates SQL group by clause components, including currency ID if applicable.

methods.name: getCurrencyIdTable
methods.description: Determines the relevant table to fetch the currency ID from based on the layout definition.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves currency details such as symbol and ID based on layout definition fields.
